text:
michelle: Quick FYI — need to align on the observability SDK compatibility matrix before we greenlight the GCP Marketplace listing. Datadog + OTel + our runtime telemetry all need to be documented.

sam: Agreed. What gating criteria are we using for Marketplace approval? e.g., dashboards, tracing end-to-end, and an installable exporter?

michelle: Right — proposal: 1) verified OTel collector config for our Dedicated/private customers; 2) Datadog dashboard templates + one-click import; 3) tracing propagation example for model shards; 4) sample ingestion load test report.

alvaro: For tracing propagation, we should include an example of context headers across our proxy -> model-worker -> redis cache. Small snippet works.

jess: I can own the dashboard templates. Need an example query for per-route token cost and p99 latency. Something like: 
```
avg:last_1h:trace.duration{service:redwood-runtime,route:generate} by {route}
```
Not exact, but will iterate.

anna-dd: Datadog side — we can bundle a dashboard tile set and an integration tile for Marketplace, but Datadog legal asks for a compatibility matrix PDF. Do you have a short compatibility table?

michelle: I'll draft a one-page matrix (SDK versions, required exporter, supported quantization connectivity). Also add known limitations (e.g., old OTel SDK <1.6 lacks trace attributes we rely on).

sam: Can we also surface GPU telemetry from our Dedicated hosts? Partner HW teams want to see utilization + memory fragmentation metrics. Datadog has GPU agent integration — we can include recommended config.

alvaro: Note: the GPU agent needs host mount /dev/nvidiactl in Private. Call that out in the install notes.

jess: Timeline ask: marketplace listing needs final assets by EOD next Tue. I can finish dashboards by Mon if I get the sample queries and example traces today.

michelle: Action items: @sam create the tracing propagation example (headers + mini trace). @alvaro add GPU agent install note and sample config. @jess prepare dashboard bundle. I will draft the compatibility PDF and upload to the shared drive.

sam: On it, will paste a tiny trace example here when done. :thumbsup:

anana-dd: (typo) anna-dd: I'll review the compatibility PDF and flag any Datadog-specific language.

deploy-bot: Meeting created: "Obs SDK matrix + GCP gating" Tue 10:00 PT — invite sent to participants.

michelle: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping me in here — we should avoid surprises during marketplace review. :eyes:
